## Summary

Describe the user-visible result and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `make test` passes
- [ ] Frontend assets were rebuilt when browser code changed
- [ ] Public API remains GET/HEAD-only
- [ ] No credentials, private data, or provider dumps are included
- [ ] Identity matching remains conservative
- [ ] Conflicting provider dates remain visible
- [ ] Documentation and changelog are updated where needed
